jobs.description:
Are you an experienced craftsman with a passion for traditional craftsmanship and decorative work?

We are a Danish construction company specialising in high-end properties, historic and listed buildings, and projects that require a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

We are looking for an experienced façade decorator, stucco worker or specialist mason with proven experience in decorative façade work and traditional building techniques.

The ideal candidate will have several years of experience working with cornices, mouldings, ornaments, decorative façades, stucco and detailed plasterwork, and will know how to recreate and restore decorative features with the precision and quality required when working on historic and architecturally significant buildings.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional bricklayer. What is most important to us is that you are highly skilled in your craft and have genuine experience with decorative and ornamental work carried out using traditional methods.

We are looking for someone who:

● Has solid and documented experience in façade decoration, stucco work or specialist masonry

● Has experience working on historic, older or listed buildings

● Is experienced in traditional techniques and materials

● Has a strong eye for detail, proportions and high-quality finishes

● Is able to work independently and take responsibility for the quality of their work

● Understands and respects the original architecture of historic buildings

● Can provide professional references and preferably photographs of previous projects

What we offer

You will become part of a professional team working on exclusive and unique properties and projects where traditional craftsmanship and attention to detail are highly valued.

You will have the opportunity to work on challenging and interesting projects where your experience and specialist skills are genuinely appreciated.

Salary will be negotiated according to qualifications and experience.

If you have the experience, craftsmanship and passion for the details that make a difference, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Please send us a short application, CV and, if possible, photographs and references from previous work.

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing the possibility of you joining our team.

Contact us for an informal conversation about the position.

Best regards, Ali

jobs.occupation: PhD position at the Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA)
jobs.description:
The Center for Polariton-driven Light-Matter Interactions (POLIMA) at The Mads Clausen Institute, University of Southern Denmark, is seeking a talented and highly motivated PhD student to work on the development of new theoretical frameworks for describing light–matter interactions in advanced van der Walls heterostructures probed by polaritons generated through inelastic tunneling. The position is funded by a Villum Young Investigator grant awarded to Assistant Professor P. André D. Gonçalves, who will supervise the PhD research.

The position is available starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The successful candidate will develop new theoretical frameworks and computational methods to investigate the fundamental limits of polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling in tunnel junctions based on van der Waals heterostructures composed of atomically thin materials. The project will employ a broad range of analytical, semi-analytical, and numerical techniques to explore electrically driven polaritonic phenomena. A major focus will be on harnessing polariton-mediated inelastic electron tunneling as a tool to probe and manipulate light–matter interactions at the nanoscale, as well as to characterize the optoelectronic response of complex quantum materials.

We welcome candidates with a strong background in condensed-matter physics and/or quantum nanophotonics who are highly motivated and eager to pursue world-class research in theoretical quantum nano-optoelectronics. Experience with scientific programming is expected, while familiarity with numerical techniques is advantageous but not required. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge research in a dynamic and ambitious young research group, supported by the POLIMA Center and its extensive network of international collaborators.

POLIMA is a Center of Excellence funded by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF) for an initial period of 6 years (2023–2028), with the possibility of a 4-year extension. The center is led by Professor N. Asger Mortensen and currently consists of two Professors, three Assistant Professors, a Lab Manager, a Center Administrator, and approximately 10–15 PhD students, postdocs, and visiting scientists. Several POLIMA researchers have attracted prestigious personal grants, e.g., Villum Investigator, Villum Young Investigator, DFF Sapere Aude, Novo Nordisk’s Foundation RECRUIT and Data Science Investigator – Emerging, and Maria Skłodowska-Curie Fellowships. Read more on POLIMA’s website.

We offer a competitive and highly collaborative research environment with close interaction between experimental and theoretical activities. You will join a thriving community of researchers and benefit from a strong network of international collaborators. Our work environment is supportive, dynamic, and designed to foster creativity and the development of innovative projects.

 

We offer:

• A PhD student position in an ambitious and supportive, international research environment.

• A dedicated supervisor research team to support the academic development of the PhD student.

• Access to state-of-the-art equipment, facilities, and infrastructure.

• A competitive salary and social benefits (e.g., health coverage, parental leave, social security, etc.) (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/international-staff/getting-settled)

POLIMA is located at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense – 1h15min by train from Copenhagen Airport. The University of Southern Denmark offers dedicated assistance and support with various practical, social, and legal aspects (housing, visa, administration, tax, etc.), especially for international candidates through our international staff office (ISO) and the administrative staff at POLIMA.

 

For further information and details about the position, application, and the research center, please contact Assistant Professor Paulo André Dias Gonçalves (padgo@mci.sdu.dk).

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Master’s and bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (copy of original and an official English translation).  

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is 31 December, 2026, at 11:59 PM / 23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process. 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The preferred start date is 1 March 2026 (may be adjusted by mutual agreement) or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an Operations & Growth Manager to join our team and play an important role in the next stage of our growth. The Role

As Operations & Growth Manager, you will help manage the day-to-day execution of the business while also working on projects that contribute directly to the company’s growth.

Your responsibilities will span five main areas:

·       Operations & Execution — approximately 30%

·       New Business Development — approximately 20%

·       Marketing & Brand Growth — approximately 20%

·       Business Intelligence & Analysis — approximately 20%

·       Processes, Systems & Automation — approximately 10%

The exact balance may evolve as the company grows. This is a role for someone who is comfortable switching between execution and strategy. 

What You'll Work On:

Operations & Retail Execution

You will help make sure the operational side runs accurately and efficiently.

This may include:

·       Managing and tracking purchase orders.

·       Monitoring inventory levels and availability.

·       Coordinating retailer orders.

·       Communicating with warehouses and logistics partners.

·       Following shipments and resolving delivery issues.

·       Managing Amazon inventory and operational requirements.

·       Supporting retailer compliance.

·       Coordinating invoices and documentation.

·       Communicating with customers, suppliers, retailers, warehouses, and external partners.

·       Improving operational accuracy.

·       Researching prospective retailers.

·       Identifying distributors and brokers.

·       Finding potential strategic partners.

·       Building lists of prospective accounts.

·       Conducting initial outreach.

·        Supporting negotiations.

·       Helping onboard new accounts.

·       Researching new retail channels.

·       Identifying geographic expansion opportunities.

Marketing & Brand Growth

You will participate in initiatives designed to increase awareness, trial, engagement, and repeat purchase.

Projects may include:

·       Influencer partnerships.

·       Creator collaborations.

·       Social media initiatives.

·       Retail marketing programs.

·       Product sampling.

·       In-store activations.

·       Tastings.

·       Amazon marketing.

·       Brand partnerships.

·       Promotional campaigns.

·       LinkedIn and social content planning.

·       Retailer-specific marketing programs.

·       Coordinating marketing assets.

·       Tracking campaign results.

·       Identifying new ways to introduce consumers.

 

Business Intelligence & Analytics

As we grow, data will become increasingly important to how we make decisions. You will help organize information and transform it into useful insights.

This may include:

·       Building dashboards.

·       Tracking sales performance.

·       Analyzing inventory.

·       Reviewing Amazon performance.

·       Monitoring retail sell-through.

·       Comparing retailer performance.

·       Tracking marketing results.

·       Identifying patterns and trends.

·       Detecting potential risks.

·       Finding opportunities hidden in the data.

·       Preparing reports for company leadership.

·       Turning information into actionable recommendations.

Systems, Processes & Automation

We are building for the next stage of growth. That means improving not only what we do, but how we do it. You will help us create systems that make the business easier to operate and scale.

Projects may include:

·       Creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

·       Documenting recurring processes.

·       Building internal templates.

·       Improving information organization.

·       Identifying repetitive manual work.

·       Finding opportunities for automation.

·       Implementing AI tools where useful.

·       Creating dashboards and internal tools.

·       Developing processes that can eventually be delegated.

·       Helping create more scalable operating systems.

 

Preferred Background 

·       A strong candidate may have experience or education in areas such as:

·       Business Administration

·       International Business

·       Operations

·       Supply Chain

·       Marketing

·       Business Development

·       Retail

·       E-commerce

Experience working with food, retail, Amazon, consumer products, logistics, distributors, brokers, or growing companies is a plus. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills are highly valuable. Experience with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Notion, Canva, CRM platforms, dashboards, AI tools, or automation platforms is also a plus.

Would you like to develop and maintain advanced electronic and acoustic production test systems as part of a skilled team?

We are looking for a Production Test Design Engineer with hardware experience to join our team in Copenhagen. INVISIO is an innovative, high-tech company with a growing portfolio in the defence and security industry.

The role

As a Production Test Design Engineer, you will help ensure reliable, high-quality end-of-line testing at our production partners. You will also shape the roadmap for our next-generation test systems as our product range and production network expand.

Because we work with production partners worldwide, the role involves periodic international travel.

Key responsibilities:

As part of the Production Test Team, you will:

• Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from defining test specifications in early project stages to implementation and verification at release, followed by ongoing improvements and maintenance.

• Specify and develop the test equipment and software required for PCBA and end-of-line product testing.

• Maintain and support production test setups remotely and on-site at our production partners.

• Help integrate our test systems with a data management platform for change control and test data monitoring.

• Maintain and further develop our Python-based test software.

With a strong hardware background, you will:

• Take ownership of hardware designs within the Production Test Team, serving as the go-to specialist for schematics and layouts for test equipment, from simple adapters to complex audio switching, power control, and programming fixtures.

• Ensure testability is built into R&D hardware designs from the earliest prototype stages.

• Apply insights and designs from early prototype testing to accelerate the development of final test equipment.

About you

The ideal candidate holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or an AP degree in Electronics, and preferably has several years of experience developing production test systems.

You have an interest in working with both theoretical and practical tasks, developing a combination of electronics, acoustics, mechanical equipment, and software for state-of-the-art test systems.

You likely bring:

• Experience in electronics design to support product testing.

• Experience implementing product test equipment for manufacturing environment, with the ability to balance theory and practice.

• Familiarity with some of the following:

• Python

• TestStand /Labview

• Altium

• Preferably, experience with acoustic testing.

• Ability to positively influence and build relationships with both internal and external team members.

• A valid driver’s licence and access to a car are required for this role.

We hope to meet an open-minded person that likes to take on a challenge and always strives to deliver high-quality results on time.

What we offer

• A varied, challenging role in an international, growing, and innovative company.

• A workplace with professional and personal growth opportunities, including training to help you achieve your career goals.

• A flexible work schedule from our HQ in Copenhagen.

• A dynamic, supportive company culture with innovation, passion, teamwork, and customer-first as our core values.

Additional information

The position is based on-site at our HQ in Hvidovre, Copenhagen. We do not offer relocation assistance.

This position requires approximately 20–50 travel days per year.

As part of our recruitment process, we are conducting a background check on the selected candidate.

How to apply

We believe in equal opportunities for all and encourage all suitable candidates to apply for our open positions.

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range: For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

NKT Photonics offers a supportive working environment with a strong focus on both professional development and work-life balance. We continue to invest in our facilities, tools, and teams to support long-term growth.

**

**

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

The Role

At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

Your Potential Background

To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Flügger is a proud supplier to professional painters and quality-conscious consumers. We are at the forefront of the movement toward a greener construction industry and support professional painters through partnerships, high-quality products, and inspiring design.

We are looking for an AI & MarTech Lead to join our growing Digital Sales team at Flügger!

At Flügger Group A/S, you will join the Digital Sales team, where we thrive in the intersection between strategy, technology and sales. You will play a pivotal role in how AI visibility defines sales strategy.

The way people find and choose paint is changing. Search is moving into AI engines, and agentic commerce is coming fast. Whoever gets found in that new landscape wins the customer long before they reach a shelf or a shop. That makes our product data one of our most valuable commercial assets, and this role is where we turn it into an advantage.

This is a role with real reach. You own the MarTech and CRM landscape, performance marketing and our AI discoverability, and you stay hands-on in the data layer yourself. You’ll build one data foundation that serves both our product feeds and AI: pay once, benefit twice. The work you do shapes what our commercial strategy can realistically aim for over the next few years.

You will report to Head of Digital Sales & Standards and take people responsibility for two specialists within Performance Marketing and CRM.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Leadership and team development

• You lead and develop the MarTech & CRM team, giving both specialists direction, sparring and technical support

• You set the frame for the team’s tools and budget

Data and technical foundation

• You own the technical data and make large volumes of data LLM-ready

• You optimise our product feeds technically and keep the data complete and correct

• You keep our CRM (HubSpot) and integration landscape healthy

• You scale our colour-as-a-product feed from a proven few hundred toward 5000+ by automating SKU, barcode and feed generation rather than doing it manually

AI discoverability and strategy

• You own our AI discoverability and structure our data, so we’re found by AI engines today and ready for agentic commerce tomorrow

• You build one data foundation that powers all channels and AI

• You follow developments within GEO, AI search and agentic commerce, and translate them into concrete initiatives

• You make sure MarTech and performance marketing pull in the same direction as the commercial strategy

Collaboration across the business

• You take part in MarTech, CRM and data forums across Commercial

• You work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products

How we measure success

• Share of products online and correct in product feeds, scaling toward 5.000+ colours

• Performance marketing efficiency measured on ROAS and qualified leads

• Our presence and findability in AI search over time

Who are you?

You are technically strong and comfortable with your hands in the data, while also able to set direction for others. You understand that MarTech only creates value when tools and data genuinely support commercial goals, and you can bridge the commercial and technical sides of the business.

We imagine that you:

• Have solid MarTech and CRM experience and can take ownership of an integration landscape, ideally including HubSpot

• Understand data flows in depth and can make data LLM-ready yourself

• Have experience with product feeds and feed optimisation at scale

• Know the performance marketing discipline well enough to lead and challenge a specialist in it

• Are forward-looking on AI-discoverability, GEO and agentic commerce

• Have leadership experience, or are ready to take that step without letting go of the craft

• Communicate comfortably in English; Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Why join our team?

• Ownership from day one. AI discoverability is a domain we’re building, not one you inherit fully formed. You set the direction, and you have the mandate and budget to act on it.

• Visible impact. Digital Sales sits close to commercial decisions. What you build in the data shows directly in how we’re found, how we sell, and where the strategy goes next.

• Hand-on leadership. You won’t be managed away from the work. This is a role where technical depth is an asset, not something you leave behind when you get a team.

• A team that works across the boundary. We sit between strategy, technology and sales, and we work closely with Platform & Experience, Analytics and Online Products rather than in silo.

• A brand with real substance behind it. Flügger has been making colour for generations, and we’re now bringing that into an AI-driven commercial reality. That’s a rare combination of heritage and greenfield work.

Does this sound like you?

Send your application no later than 26th of October. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait too long to apply.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Head of Digital Sales & Standards, Jens Havreballe on +45 20 87 03 36.

Ansøgningsfrist: 28. oktober 2026

Arbejdsplads: Islevdalvej 151, 2610 Rødovre

Beskæftigelsesgrad: Fulltime

Varighed: Permanent contract

Stilling: AI & MarTech Lead

For mere information

Kontakt: Jens Birch Havreballe

E-mail: jehav@flugger.com

Telefon: (+45) 20870336

I Flügger ser vi udelukkende på kombinationen af personlige og faglige kompetencer og kvalifikationer, når vi vurderer kandidaters egnethed. Vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og individets ret til at være sig selv med lige muligheder.

Om Flügger

Flügger Group er en international børsnoteret virksomhed med en omsætning på ca. 2,2 milliarder DKK og ca. 1700 medarbejdere på tværs af grænser. Vi er en familiegrundlagt og -ledet virksomhed, stor nok til at gøre en forskel, men stadig lille nok til at bevare vores entreprenørånd. Vores team består af dedikerede og dygtige mennesker, der virkelig engagerer sig og opbygger en uovertruffen ekspertise indefra.

Working at Flügger

We are an informal, down-to-earth workplace with high ambitions, and we constantly strive to improve ourselves and our business. Our employees are the very core of the company and key to our continued success. When our employees grow, Flügger grows, making continuous development a high priority in Flügger.

Our headquarter is based in Denmark but you will find that we also have positions in Sweden, Norway, Poland, Iceland and China. We pride ourselves on our international outlook and it is important for us to create a culture of diversity, well-being, and good cooperation across departments throughout Flügger. We believe that a diverse team fosters creativity and drives success.

Ready for a colourful career at Flügger?

When you work at Flügger Group, you help bring colour and joy to countless customer projects, whether they are in urban spaces or in private homes. To us, it is not just about paints and painting products; it is about providing our customers with professional advice and the right solution that guarantees a successful outcome.

So, if you are passionate about making a difference and you thrive in a collaborative environment, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Tax Professional, Customer Handling, Securities Tax Services (Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Are you customer-focused, structured and motivated by working in an operational area where quality, documentation and service delivery are key? Do you enjoy supporting customers and advisers, coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring that processes run efficiently from start to finish?

We are looking for a detail-oriented colleague to join our Customer Handling Team/Tax Services team in Copenhagen. The team serves as a primary point of contact for advisers and customers and plays an important role in onboarding, documentation management, customer support and service delivery related to securities tax services.

On clients’ behalf, Danske Bank applies for a reduction in foreign tax on returns from securities held in customers’ custody accounts. This includes relief of foreign dividend and interest tax, either at source or through tax reclaim processes. The service is complementary to Danske Bank’s custody service and is particularly relevant for clients earning income on foreign financial instruments, where a tax reduction may be available under applicable double taxation agreements.

**About Securities Tax Services

**Securities Tax Services is part of Danske Bank’s tax area and is responsible for handling services related to withholding tax on securities. The area consists of several teams located in Denmark and Lithuania, working closely together across locations, functions and customer segments.

You will join a team of skilled specialists who support corporate, institutional and other customer segments. We value collaboration, curiosity, continuous learning and a strong focus on delivering high-quality service in a well-controlled environment.

**Your role

**As a team member in Customer Handling, you will support customers and advisers with inquiries, documentation and service-related matters. You will help ensure that customer agreements, onboarding, offboarding and service changes are handled correctly and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Acting as a first point of contact for customer and adviser inquiries

• Handling customer onboarding and offboarding activities

• Ensuring customer agreements and service documentation are sent, received and registered correctly

• Collecting, reviewing and maintaining required customer documentation

• Supporting changes to customer preferences and service setups

• Following up with customers and advisers on outstanding documentation and requests

• Coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient service delivery

• Participating in client meetings and supporting customer relationship management

• Maintaining and updating information in internal systems

• Supporting controls to ensure accurate and compliant processing

• Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and service quality

The role combines recurring operational tasks with customer interaction and collaboration across teams. You will get exposure to securities services, withholding tax processes, custody-related services and post-trade operations.

**About You

**We are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who enjoys working with customers, documentation and operational processes. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly and can manage several activities while maintaining attention to detail.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from customer service, client support, operations, financial services or a similar area

• Have a customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills

• Are comfortable working with documentation, regulations and operational processes

• Can manage multiple tasks while maintaining high accuracy

• Collaborate well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and locations

• Are proactive, curious and willing to learn in a complex environment

• Have strong English skills, both written and spoken

Experience from Asset Services, post-trade operations, custody services or withholding tax is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team environment where you can develop your expertise through varied work and mentorship opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Your career will progress through exposure to diverse tax challenges and continuous learning opportunities.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would be delighted to hear from you if this opportunity aligns with your career aspirations. Please reach out to our hiring manager Nicolai William Schou Hansen at nicoh@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Scientific Data Engineer - to build systems and structures
jobs.description:
Orbis is growing fast. As our biology and chemistry teams grow, we need our data infrastructure to scale as well. We are looking for a Scientific Data Engineer to build systems and structures that capture data accurately and smoothly so that the science team can focus on the science.

About the role

You’ll work closely with biology, chemistry, design and data science teams to understand how they work and what they need from their data, identify areas for improvement and then build solutions using both commercial and custom tools.

This is a chance to join a growing biotech company at a crucial moment as we invest in our lab and data infrastructure, helping build a cutting-edge data platform, designing workflows and building pipelines. This role would suit someone who loves data and code. Someone with a chemistry or biology background with a computational focus, or a software engineer with experience working in a scientific environment.

You will be working onsite in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Develop and manage the Orbis data platform, spanning commercial software and custom solutions, including implementing new systems and migrating existing data

• Work with chemistry, biology and data science teams to gather requirements, prototype solutions, and harmonise data operations across the organisation

• Write and maintain ETL data pipelines to streamline data ingestion and organisation

• Safeguard data integrity and quality in line with FAIR principles

• Collaborate with software engineers and data scientists to enable AI&ML operations

• Act as the go-to contact for lab scientists using our data products and infrastructure

Qualifications & experience

• A degree in chemistry, biology, bioinformatics or a related field

• A strong passion for data in drug discovery

• 3+ years of industry experience in a scientific environment, with hands-on exposure to drug discovery data and how it flows from design through synthesis and testing

• Good working knowledge of Python and common data libraries

• Experience with relational databases and SQL

• Experience designing data structures for scientific data

• Strong communication skills and a track record of working collaboratively with scientists

Nice to have

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP)

• Software engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD, Docker and code testing

• Experience with ELN or LIMS systems (e.g. Dotmatics, CDD Vault, Revvity Signals)

Application

Please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mia Danielsen (part of

DEDENROTH) if you have any questions about the role or the process.

Phone: +45 26178142

Email: mia.danielsen@orbismedicines.com

More about Orbis Medicines

The Orbis’ nGen platform designs macrocycles with oral bioavailability by combining AI technologies with automated synthesis and high-throughput screening of real compounds.

Orbis Medicines has been awarded a 2025 Endpoints 11 title as one of biopharma's most exciting start-ups. This marks the first time a Nordic biotech has received this honor – highlighting the disruptive potential of Orbis Medicines. With a recent EUR 90 million Series A funding round, led by top-tier investors such as NEA, Eli Lilly, Cormorant, the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark and founding investors Novo Holdings and Forbion, Orbis Medicines are well-positioned for significant growth and long-term success. The confidence of these investors validates the potential to bring groundbreaking therapies to the market.

Orbis Medicines has an established R&D site in Copenhagen that includes a state-of-the-art laboratory and a team of +40 experienced professionals and scientists. We offer the excitement of a start-up, opportunities for professional growth, and the opportunity to be at the forefront of biotech innovation. Your ideas and contributions will shape the future of medicine. Please visit the website for more details www.orbismedicines.com.

As Materials Scientist, you will develop and implement wafer growth processes using molecular beam epitaxy methods and ensure successful execution with highest material quality. You'll work closely with technical leads to coordinate scientific development and move the quantum dots technology further.

You’ll be part of a collaborative team that ensures Sparrow Quantum’s research and innovation projects are executed with excellence.

Responsibilities

• 
Develop wafer-scale epitaxy and in close collaboration with nanofabrication activities, quantum dot characterization, and numerical modelling activities

• 
Build capabilities to analyse and test new devices

• 
Implement and document processes and operating procedures, tests & specifications

• 
Track variation and process capability, identify and support continuous improvement initiatives towards tool and process improvement

• 
MBE maintenance and troubleshooting

• 
Cross-teams collaboration

Who You Are

• 
You always strive for excellence and want to deliver work that you’re proud of

• 
You’re looking for challenges, continuous improvement and opportunities to grow

• 
You are collaborative; high-ownership teams bring out the best in you

Must-Have Qualifications

• 
PhD in physics/materials science/mechanical engineering or similar

• 
Hands-on experience with UHV systems, various pumps and their maintenance

• 
A proven record of working with molecular beam epitaxy systems

• 
Deep understanding of epitaxial growth preferably with III-V based materials

• 
Experience in basic sample characterization, including but not limited to SEM, AFM, XRD, TEM

• 
Curiosity and desire to investigate potential issues/perfect final result

• 
Willingness to collaborate and deliver results in a clear and structured way

• 
Strong focus on the final goal, self-discipline and prioritization

Nice-to-Have Experience

• 
Experience with characterization techniques such as photoluminescence, transport measurements at 4K via van der Pauw method

• 
Knowledge of coding/ AI implementation to facilitate data extraction and analysis

• 
Basic knowledge of fabrication tools (scriber, wet benches, asher, optical microscopes, spinners)

What You Can Expect

• 
Working in a high-performance team of highly motivated people towards photonic quantum computing

• 
Contributing to scientific publications and patents

• 
Representing the company at scientific conferences

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Flexible working hours (with up to 10-20% working from home)

• 
Lunch paid by the company

• 
Possibility of traveling to our collaborators for new insights and knowledge sharing

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment at the border between research and industry

Why Sparrow Quantum ?

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility
